faq.q: Can I add multiple text elements?
faq.a: Currently, the tool supports one text element per image. For multiple text layers, you can download the result and upload it again to add a second text element. We're considering multi-text support in a future update.

faq.q: Will my image be uploaded to a server?
faq.a: No. All processing happens entirely in your browser using the Canvas API. Your images and text never leave your device. There is no server that receives or stores your files.

We offer 10 curated Google Fonts that cover a wide range of styles. Custom font uploads aren't currently supported, but we've selected fonts that work well for most use cases — from professional to decorative.

faq.q: How do I position the text precisely?
faq.a: You can drag the text directly on the preview canvas. For quick placement, use the 9-position grid in the sidebar. For pixel-perfect positioning, zoom in on the canvas and drag slowly.

faq.q: Does the outline work with transparent text?
faq.a: Yes! You can set the text color to any value, including colors with the opacity slider. The outline is drawn separately, so it will still appear even when the text fill is semi-transparent.

faq.q: What's the best text style for memes?
faq.a: Use white text, black outline (3-5px width), Impact or Bebas Neue font, bold weight, and large size (60-100px). Position at top or bottom of the image. This is the classic meme format that's instantly recognizable.

faq.q: Can I use this for multiline text?
faq.a: Yes. Type your text with line breaks in the text area, and each line will be rendered separately on the canvas with consistent spacing. This is useful for quotes or multi-line captions.
